intro.title: What is Master Legends League?
intro.body1: Master Legends League (MLL) is a play-to-earn football management game on the Polygon blockchain. Build your club, scout players as NFTs, line up your squad and earn real USDC.
intro.body2: The game combines club management strategy with DeFi mechanics: your lineup generates passive USDC income per hour, and your NFT players can be traded on the internal marketplace.

scout.title: NFT Players — Scout & Rarities
scout.body: Players are minted via Scout for {{price}} each, with a limit of {{max}} scouts per user. Each scout reveals a random rarity:
scout.staminaNote: ⚡ Max stamina: 100. Players in the lineup drain stamina per hour based on rarity. When it hits 0, the Coach automatically removes them.

farming.title: Farming — Passive USDC Income
farming.body: Your 11-player lineup generates USDC per hour while you're offline. The calculation considers the total overwall of your 11 starters and your stadium bonus.
farming.formulaNote: Requires a hired coach. Stops when stamina runs out and the player leaves the stadium.

stamina.title: Stamina & Training Center
stamina.body: Players in the lineup lose stamina on the field based on rarity. Benched players do not decay — they only recover with a Coach.
stamina.coachNote: 🎽 The Coach automatically rotates the squad: removes players with 0 stamina and puts players with 100 stamina on the field.

merger.title: Player Merger
merger.body: Fuse 5 players of the same rarity and receive 1 of the next rarity. Common becomes uncommon. The fee is GMT. The five cards are consumed and the same card cannot enter two fusions.
merger.note: A legendary is worth 3,125 GMT and is not an ingredient. The new card's OVERWALL is rolled in the output rarity band.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.body: Buy and sell NFT players with other users. The marketplace charges a fee on each sale.

buildings.title: Club Buildings
buildings.body: Upgrade club buildings to unlock bonuses and features. Upgrade cost: {{formula}} (max level 10).

referral.title: Referral Program
referral.body: Refer friends and earn automatic USDC commissions plus an exclusive bonus NFT.
referral.note: Commissions are automatically credited to your in-game USDC balance.

pass.title: Season Pass
pass.body: The Season Pass unlocks exclusive rewards and accelerated progress. Cost: {{price}}.

museum.title: Club Museum
museum.body: The Museum records your club's history: trophies won, retired players and stadium evolution.
museum.lifetimeValue: Total USDC earned by the club
